title: Heat Pump vs Gas Furnace Running Cost by State 2026
summary: State-by-state 2026 cost per million Btu: heat pump versus gas furnace depends on the electricity-to-gas price ratio; resistance heat always loses; 25C ended.

assertions.quote: It depends on the ratio of your electricity price to your gas price.
at national average prices gas is slightly cheaper per unit of heat than a heat pump running at COP 3.0.
expensive-electricity, cheap-gas states (Alaska, Michigan, New York) favor gas.
A heat pump at COP 3.0 delivers the same heat for one-third the electricity, $17.89.
No federal 25C credit for heat pumps placed in service after December 31, 2025.
The Section 25C credit (30%, up to $2,000 for qualifying heat pumps) ended for property placed in service after December 31, 2025.
Dropping gas entirely removes the gas utility's fixed monthly customer charge, which the per-Btu table ignores.
In a very cold climate a standard unit spends hours near COP 1.5 to 2.0 and may fall back to resistance strips
A heat pump is also your air conditioner.
